title: Warehouse-Loss Lookback Base by FBN Program and Tenure
content:
| Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment | Active at least 24 whole months since its activation date | Lookback base for warehouse-loss claims |
|---|---|---|
| FBN Scale Program, FBN Premier Program or FBN Enterprise Program | yes | 6 months (long lookback base) |
| FBN Core Program or FBN Growth Program | yes | 4 months (middle lookback base) |
| any program | no | neither base in this schedule |
| FBN Starter Program | yes or no | neither base in this schedule |

**Rule.** The lookback base for the claimable lost units of a warehouse-loss case is the long lookback base of 6 months for an enrollment in FBN Scale Program, FBN Premier Program or FBN Enterprise Program that has been active for at least the lookback tenure threshold of 24 whole months since its activation date, and the middle lookback base of 4 months for an enrollment in FBN Core Program or FBN Growth Program active for at least that same threshold of 24 whole months. Both conditions — the program and the tenure — must hold together. For every other enrollment this schedule sets no lengthened base.

## Reading the tenure

Tenure is the number of whole months from the enrollment's activation date to the handling date, a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month. The program is the program the enrollment is in on the handling date.

| Hypothetical enrollment | Whole months active | Lookback base under this schedule |
|---|---|---|
| FBN Premier Program, activated 10 March two years before a 10 March handling date | 24 | 6 months |
| FBN Premier Program, activated 11 March two years before a 10 March handling date | 23 | none from this schedule |
| FBN Growth Program, active 30 whole months | 30 | 4 months |
| FBN Starter Program, active 40 whole months | 40 | none from this schedule |
